add_block.new_heading: Keto catering for corporate events, parties and weddings
new_paragraphs: Keto catering flexes to nearly any occasion — corporate meals, birthdays, celebrations and even wedding tables all work on a keto menu. Corporate keto catering in Dubai suits health-focused teams, client lunches and boardroom dinners, where a clean low-carb spread keeps every guest sharp through the afternoon. For social hosts, keto party catering turns a birthday or milestone into something guilt-free and generous, and keto catering for events of every size scales the same menu from an intimate eight-seat table to a hundred-plus guests. At a wedding or engagement, a dedicated keto station lets diet-following guests eat as well as the rest of the table instead of picking at sides. Whatever the setting, we adjust staff, station count and format to match, so keto party catering Dubai never feels like a compromise. Tell us the headcount and the mood, and the menu and styling follow.

new_paragraphs: The keto menu is bespoke, built around clean proteins, healthy fats and low-carb vegetables you can push in any direction. A typical spread runs grilled and roasted proteins (steak, lamb, chicken thigh, salmon, prawns), rich fat-forward sides (avocado, halloumi, roasted cauliflower, buttered greens, seed crackers), and keto desserts made without sugar or flour — think dark-chocolate mousse, berry-and-cream pots and almond-base bakes. As keto food catering, every item is prepared fresh and macro-checked, with no hidden sugars, grains or starch. Want a Mediterranean-leaning low-carb table, a high-protein spread for a fitness crowd, or a keto meal-prep run for the week? The chef adapts the keto menu Dubai clients ask for to your taste, your guests and the season, and can label carb counts per dish on request.

new_paragraphs: Macros and allergies are designed in from the start, not bolted on afterwards. Specific keto macro targets are agreed with you in advance — we build every dish low-carb and high-fat, though we don't publish fixed nutrition guarantees. The same menu can be made gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free or halal, with meat prepared to halal standards on request, so a mixed table eats the same beautiful food instead of a lesser "special" plate. On styling, the chef and team dress the table to your setting, from a polished corporate room to a relaxed villa dinner, with live cooking stations if you want the theatre of proteins seared to order. The result reads as a considered occasion, not a stack of macro boxes on a sideboard.

add_block.new_heading: How much does keto catering cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Keto catering in Dubai costs from AED 700 per person, with the format setting the range. Buffet-style trays and drop-off are the most affordable keto catering option; plated, staffed service sits higher; and luxury keto catering with premium proteins, a live station and full styling sits higher again. Most hosts pay per head, but set keto catering packages — from around AED 1,200 for a small group, scaling to AED 2,400 and AED 3,600 for larger counts — can give better value when your numbers are fixed. Keto home catering for a private villa is priced the same way, by guests, menu and service level. Keto catering prices carry no hidden add-ons: your itemised quote lists food, staff, equipment and delivery separately so the keto catering cost is clear before you commit. Compare formats in our Dubai catering price guide , then send your details for an exact figure.

new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the occasion, we carry the work. For precise, macro-driven cooking like keto, that is often Ahmed Al-Rashid , who brings 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique; he designs each menu as a collaboration with the host, every course timed, seasoned and portioned to exacting standards. Keto catering sits alongside villa weddings, yacht celebrations and corporate galas across Dubai. Every keto catering booking includes, with client reviews added as events run.

new_paragraphs: How much does keto catering cost in Dubai?

From AED 700 per person, quoted to your guest count, menu and service. Buffet and drop-off sit at the lower end; plated service with staff sits higher. Set keto catering packages from AED 1,200 suit fixed numbers. Send your details for an itemised quote.
What is included in keto catering?
Included is a vetted chef, service staff where needed, keto menu design, plating, setup and cleanup, plus fresh on-site cooking from clean proteins and healthy fats. You host; we handle the rest.
Can you hit strict keto macros and allergy needs?

Yes. Specific macro targets are agreed with you in advance, and every dish is built low-carb with no sugar, grains or starch. We don't publish fixed nutrition guarantees, and we can also make the menu gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free or halal.
Do you offer keto catering for corporate events and parties?

Yes. Corporate keto catering in Dubai covers client hospitality and team meals, and keto party catering covers birthdays, celebrations and private events, scaled from an intimate table to a large gathering.
Can I get keto catering near me across Dubai?
Yes. We cover the whole city, from Palm Jumeirah and Jumeirah to Downtown, Dubai Marina, Business Bay and DIFC, serving villas, apartments and offices.
Do you offer keto catering packages?
Yes. Per-head pricing suits most events, while set keto catering packages from AED 1,200 work well for fixed guest counts and budgets. We will point you to whichever gives better value.
How far ahead should I book keto catering in Dubai?
Book about a week ahead for a small dinner. Allow two to four weeks for weddings, large parties and peak dates, when the top chefs book up fastest.
For keto catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
